title: Afotu a Wɔakyerɛw Wɔ Nyansa Mu
intro: Fa no sɛ wugyina onipa bi nkyɛn a ɛnyɛ anwonwade anaa ahenni nti na wonim no, na mmom nsɛm a ɛda so ara kyerɛ koma kwan nnɛ. Allah akoa yi nyaa akyɛdeɛ a ɛsom boɔ na ɔhwiee aseda guu afotuo biara a wɔde maa osuani kumaa bi a wɔdɔ no mu.
clues: Allah de nyansa hyiraa me, na wɔhyɛɛ me sɛ menda ase wɔ ho.
Mede afotu a ɛyɛ brɛoo kasa kyerɛɛ me babarima no, na mede ɔdɔ ne dwen bɔɔ kɔkɔ.
Meka kyerɛɛ me babarima no sɛ, sɛ mede ahokafoɔ bɛka Allah ho a, ɛyɛ bɔne kɛseɛ.
Mituu me ba no fo sɛ ɔmfa mpaebɔ nsi hɔ, ɔmfa nea ɛteɛ nhyɛ, ɔmma bɔne, na onnya boasetɔ.
Mebɔɔ me ba no kɔkɔ sɛ ɔmfa ahantan nnane n’anim na ɔmfa ahantan nnantew asase so.
Mekyerɛɛ me babarima no sɛ ɔmfa ne ho nkɔ fam na ɔmma ne nne nkɔ fam, efisɛ nnyigyei a emu yɛ den sen biara ne mfurum a wɔrebɔ ose.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
